TITLE:
Patient POV — Dental Hygienist Performing Scaling

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Natural modern Japanese dental clinic photography.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin, hair, and fabric textures.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful adult Japanese female dental hygienist in her mid-20s.
Dark brown hair styled in a loose elegant updo with soft face-framing strands.
Large almond-shaped dark brown eyes.
Natural elegant makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Slender yet distinctly curvy feminine hourglass figure.
Delicate narrow shoulders and slim overall frame.
Very full, naturally prominent bust with realistic softness and weight.
Strong natural bust-to-waist contrast.
Very slim waist and slender arms.
Realistic adult anatomy and proportions.

OUTFIT:
Fitted white short-sleeve summer dental clinic uniform with thin black piping.
Wide and moderately deep square neckline, broadly open across the collarbones, décolletage, and chest.
Extremely thin, lightweight, white stretch fabric with a delicate fine-knit weave, naturally fitted around her full bust and slim waist.
The white fabric has visibly reduced opacity under the strong clinic lighting; the contrasting color and general silhouette of the undergarment beneath can be faintly discerned through the material, especially where the fabric is stretched.
High-waisted fitted beige clinical pants with a slim matching belt.
Small professional name badge.
White medical face mask and disposable gloves.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Bright, clean, modern Japanese dental clinic.
White and pale wood interior with subtle dental equipment in the softly blurred background.
The viewer is lying fully reclined in a dental treatment chair while receiving dental scaling.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
The dental hygienist leans naturally forward over the reclined viewer while performing dental scaling.
Her face and upper torso are relatively close because of the realistic working distance.
Her head is slightly lowered and her eyes are calmly focused downward toward the patient's mouth below the visible frame.
Her fitted square-neck uniform naturally follows her feminine upper-body contours as she leans forward.
Professional working posture, not posing for the camera.

CAMERA:
Strict first-person POV from the patient's own eyes while lying fully reclined.
The patient's body, face, mouth, and teeth are completely invisible.
Looking naturally upward toward the hygienist leaning over the viewer.
Her masked face, eyes, wide neckline, shoulders, and upper torso dominate the composition.
Her hands and dental instruments remain below and outside the visible frame.
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Natural close-distance iPhone perspective, approximately 28mm equivalent.
Moderately shallow depth of field.

LIGHTING:
Bright soft dental-clinic lighting with subtle natural daylight.
Natural skin tones and realistic neutral white balance.

DETAILS:
Realistic skin pores and individual hair strands.
Natural fabric texture, stretch, and folds caused by her forward-leaning posture.
Authentic dental-clinic atmosphere.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No visible patient or patient reflection.
No patient's mouth or teeth.
No dental instruments prominently visible.
No third-person perspective.
No direct eye contact with the camera.
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No excessive beauty retouching.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
